description: Employer tool, one call. Describe who you need to hire. If at least 3 consented candidates in the Loker Dollar pool match strongly, you get an ANONYMIZED shortlist back (opaque ids, headline, region, skills, 0–100 score — no PII) and the same shortlist is emailed to contact_email. If the pool has no strong match, the result says so; ask the user whether to post the role free on the Loker Dollar network, then call again with publish_if_no_match=true — the listing goes live automatically when it passes our scam check, and every applicant is forwarded to contact_email.

apply_url.description: Optional. If set, applicants are sent there; otherwise Loker Dollar hosts the apply form and forwards each applicant to contact_email.

brief.description: Who you need, in plain words: role, must-have skills, seniority, remote/location, budget if you have one (30–4000 chars).

contact_email.description: Your work email. The shortlist (or the listing confirmation) goes here.

location.description: Optional, e.g. `Remote — APAC` or a city.

publish_if_no_match.description: Only after the user confirms: post the role as a free listing when the pool has no strong match.

name: hire
